## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

   **Bugs and stability.**
      3 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: May 8, 2026 - Jul 23, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users report reliability problems. This points to quality gaps competitors can exploit.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Haru Mcrmbng_, Jul 22, 2026, 1/5: "everything was good,the app was great to be general until you have to "pay" for the "daily rewards"?????its disappointing actually, it keep updating almost every day that it end up with bugs and really no wonder why the messangers and authors are lowkey getting low and disappearing with the new update nothing is free😔"
            2. _Irislene Oliveira Silva_, Jun 19, 2026, 1/5: "There are a lot of bugs. The app has good stories and a beautiful interface, but it crashes frequently and sometimes stops responding, making reading difficult. It has potential, but needs more stability and optimization to offer a better experience."
            3. _El-Housna Ali Abdallah (“Jayden”)_, May 8, 2026, 1/5: "I really liked this application, it was perfect but since the updates, it has become awful. Bugs EVERY DAY. We had to wait a week for them to fix it and even after announcing that they had “fixed” it, the application was still bugging. The text keeps cutting off even after the so-called "problem fix". Additionally, there have been chat entry limits but only on ONE of my bots, why? In short, rubbish."

## **Pricing and paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

   **Pricing and paywall.**
      3 recent review(s) mention pricing and paywall.
      Review window: Jul 22, 2026 - Jul 24, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention price, subscriptions, or paywalls. This can signal pricing sensitivity in the niche.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _爱`_, Jul 24, 2026, 1/5: "i understand the cost of spending to get hearts, but the weekly login doesn't seem very fair 🙂‍↕️ I hope you'll cancel the weekly subscription in the future 🙂👌🏻"
            2. _Kavya Agarwal_, Jul 22, 2026, 1/5: "Did you seriously hide the daily 50 heart reward behind a paywall? surely you also want a downfall like chai did, enjoy.."
            3. _Natalia Carlos Diaz_, Jul 23, 2026, 2/5: "The update regarding hearts and the "check-in" feature was terrible. As someone who has been using Doki Chat for a long time, freezing the daily hearts felt like a low blow; I mean, that feature helped drive regular visits to the app and served as a sort of reward. Now, everything has to be paid for. Sure, you can still get hearts by watching ads, but having to sit through them is annoying. It was—and still is—the best app, but those updates... 🤢Please remove the payment "check-in" update"
